title: Companions
intro: Census phase: vanilla data, plus the Ehlnofey target band of each record. The Companions: the Circle and the members of Jorrvaskr, and the Companion Ghosts of Ysgramor's Tomb. The Circle's werewolf forms are scripted race changes with no record of their own; the wolf spirits are on Werebeasts → *Wolf Spirits*. No CC pack adds a Companion.
